description.zh: 是否开启自动预测，false：不开启， true：开启，默认开启
description.en: Specifies whether to enable auto prediction. Valid values: `false` (disabled) and `true` (enabled). Default: `true`.

description.zh:
content字段是图片URL时：false
body为base64的内容时：true
description.en:
Set to `false` when providing a file URL in the `Content` parameter.
Set to `true` when providing Base64-encoded content in the `Body` parameter.
The Base64-encoded content of the image.

description.zh: 图片或pdf文件可访问地址
description.en: The publicly accessible URL of an image or a PDF file.
